decision: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
event_name: Date 20 May 2022 Time 16:48 2022 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 15 & 16) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Impeding of Car 44 by Car 14 at turn 12.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that the driver of car 14 was driving slowly on the racing line between turn 12 and turn 13 and unnecessarily impeded car 44, requiring car 44 to take avoiding action. Consistent with the drivers' request for the Stewards to enforce impeding during P1 and P2 this season, the Stewards issue a Reprimand (driving).
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 14 Impeding
